title: Behavioral Containment: Source-to-Binary Function Matching for 1-Day Vulnerability Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.25394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vulnerabilities in reused open-source code often propagate into deployed binaries. Detecting them requires source-to-binary function matching, which locates the affected source function in a binary. Applying prior binary-to-binary approaches to this task would require compiling the source code with the same build configuration as the target binary, which is usually unavailable. Decompiling the binary does not make prior source-to-source approaches work either, because decompiled code differs substantially from the original source code.   We observe that compilation transforms the code of a function but largely preserves its behavior. A binary function that implements a source function therefore contains its behavior, a property we call behavioral containment. translated_title: 行为包含：面向1-day漏洞检测的源码到二进制函数匹配
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2611.25394v1，公告类型：新论文）：重用的开源代码中的漏洞往往会传播到已部署的二进制文件中。检测这类漏洞需要进行源码到二进制的函数匹配，即在二进制文件中定位受影响的源函数。若将以往的二进制到二进制方法应用于该任务，则需要使用与目标二进制文件相同的构建配置来编译源代码，而这种配置通常是不可获得的；对二进制文件进行反编译也无法使以往的源码到源码方法生效，因为反编译得到的代码与原始源代码存在很大差异。我们观察到，编译虽然会转换函数的代码，但在很大程度上保留了其行为。因此，实现某个源函数的二进制函数中包含了该源函数的行为，我们将这一特性称为“行为包含”。基于这一观察，我们提出了SBIND，它对二进制文件进行反编译，并检查行为包含而非比较代码。SBIND通过行为路径来表示每个函数……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心创新是提出“行为包含”这一特性（即编译保留函数行为），并据此设计出SBIND方法，通过反编译二进制并检查行为包含而非直接比较代码，实现无需相同构建配置的源码到二进制函数匹配，从而检测已部署二进制中的1-day漏洞。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the property of behavioral containment—that compilation transforms code while largely preserving behavior—and presents SBIND, which decompiles binaries and checks behavioral containment instead of comparing code, enabling source-to-binary function matching for 1-day vulnerability detection without requiring the original build configuration.
